development_also_uses: 2026-10-17-search-batch-validation.json (consumed in the previous batch; development only)

arms.T: B + test intent recognizes test, tests, tested and testing
arms.C2: B + file-level concept coverage: in default broad delivery, files whose hits together match two or more cleaned concepts go first; queries with an exact identifier are skipped; the cleaned filler list is used only for this ordering

tuning: Only C2 may change before validation (coverage threshold and filler list), using development data only. The final C2/TC patches are hash-bound in a candidate record before validation runs. T is fixed now.
c2_acceptance_vs_B: compare() passes on new development and validation: no aggregate file or visible loss at 5, 24 or scoped; inspection no net loss; p95 <= max(0.1 s, 1.5 x B)
zero individual judged-file or visible-quote losses in both new splits, on the 24 previous-batch questions and on the 40 earlier regression questions
development: >= +2 first-five file judgments across >= 2 questions in >= 2 packs; validation: >= +1 first-five file judgment
exact-symbol control responses identical to B on every page
candidate generation identical to B on every page (C2 changes only delivery order)
ranking gate: C2 vs same-environment B within net Acc@5 loss 2 and MRR@5 drop 0.01
a unit fixture where a file splits two concepts over two chunks fails on B and passes on C2
t_acceptance_vs_B: test-intent questions (both new splits): primary test-file label at 5 gains >= +2 in total, with zero individual judged-file or visible-quote losses
every question that does not contain test, tests, tested or testing has identical delivery and generation (negative control)
ranking gate: T vs same-environment B within net Acc@5 loss 2 and MRR@5 drop 0.01
shipping: Ship each change that passes its own rules. If both pass, TC must also show zero individual losses vs B on every set. A change that fails ships nothing; the rejection is published with its diagnosis.
validation: Runs once, on B, T, C2 and TC, after the candidate record is written. No tuning after validation results are opened.

bounds.sources: cached pinned packs only; QUALITY_ALLOW_DOWNLOADS unset; no models, downloads or cloud

scope: Implementer-authored, source-bound, non-exhaustive labels; not independent user or agent outcomes.
